## Mechanism

**Entry:** HTF-gated directional scoring (details in shotgun_scalper_stage4 logic) triggers when higher-timeframe alignment confirms direction and volume ratio exceeds threshold.  
**Exit:**  
- TP1: exit 66.7% of position at +75% premium (tp_premium_pct=0.75)  
- Stop: catastrophe cap at -35% premium (stop_premium_pct=-0.35)  
- Time stop: forced exit after 12 minutes (time_stop_min=12)  
- Strike: ATM + 2 offset (strike_offset=2) for put bias (inferred from J's edge context)  
- Profit-lock: chandelier arms at +60% premium (chandelier_arm_pct=0.6), trails 15% off high-water mark  
- Volume filter: vol_ratio_threshold=1.2 requires current bar volume ≥ 1.2× 20-bar average
